blurb: Dos Lagos Golf Course offers golf play with various green fee rates depending on time of day. They provide annual memberships with benefits including advanced tee time privileges and merchandise discounts. The venue also hosts corporate events, meetings, weddings, and private celebrations in their Arroyo Room with full amenities.
